scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,MANAGEMENT,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm run dev:console" "pnpm run dev:management" "pnpm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,MANAGEMENT,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm run build:console" "pnpm run build:management" "pnpm run build:backend"
scripts.lint: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,MANAGEMENT,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm run lint:console" "pnpm run lint:management" "pnpm run lint:backend"
scripts.lint:fix: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,MANAGEMENT,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm --filter console lint -- --fix" "pnpm --filter management lint -- --fix" "pnpm --filter nest-backend lint -- --fix"
scripts.format: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,MANAGEMENT,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm run format:console" "pnpm run format:management" "pnpm run format:backend"
scripts.format:write: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,MANAGEMENT,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm --filter console format -- --write" "pnpm --filter management format -- --write" "pnpm --filter nest-backend format -- --write"
scripts.type-check: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,MANAGEMENT,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm run type-check:console" "pnpm run type-check:management" "pnpm run type-check:backend"
scripts.test: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,MANAGEMENT,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm run test:console" "pnpm run test:management" "pnpm run test:backend"
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,MANAGEMENT,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm run test:watch:console" "pnpm run test:watch:management" "pnpm run test:watch:backend"
scripts.test:cov: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,MANAGEMENT,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm run test:cov:console" "pnpm run test:cov:management" "pnpm run test:cov:backend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n CONSOLE,BACKEND -c auto "pnpm run start:console" "pnpm run start:backend"
scripts.pre-commit:check: pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run format:write && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run test
scripts.quality: pnpm run lint && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run test
scripts.quality:fix: pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run format:write && pnpm run type-check
